description: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (PPL) across varying ratios of activated parameters, measured as a percentage. The x-axis, labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)", ranges from 25 to 100 in reverse order, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL", uses a linear scale from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The red dashed line, representing the "Transformer" model, remains flat at a PPL of approximately 11.6 across all activation ratios. The gray line with square markers, labeled "Only MoHD FFN", starts at a PPL of about 11.5 at 100% activation, decreases slightly to a PPL of 11.2 at 50%, and then increases to approximately 11.8 at 25%. The purple line with circle markers, labeled "Only MoHD ATTN", begins at a PPL of around 11.5 and rises sharply to approximately 14.0 at 25%. The blue line with cross markers, labeled "MoHD ATTN + MLP", starts at a PPL of 11.5 and increases steadily to about 13.8 at 25%. A legend in the top left corner identifies the four methods compared.
